analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 94,085) vs SMA5 (KRW 94,100) / SMA20 (KRW 105,175) / SMA50 (KRW 156,137) — short-term resistance, below mid/long-term trend.
· Below SMA100 (KRW 137,434) / SMA200 (KRW 98,168) — confirms strong mid-to-long-term bearish trend.
· 52-week position (30.8%) + approaching historical low price area.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (40.3→41.4) + insufficient oversold exit, neutral zone stagnation.
· MACD histogram trajectory (1637.0239→1637.0239) + slowing improvement, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band KRW 105,175) + 63.83% band width indicates contraction after expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 68,045) + based on Pivot S1 (KRW 57,993).
· Swing resistance (KRW 95,500) + potential for short-term bounce upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.63x) + low confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (potential accumulation phase, requires confirmation of short-term bounce with increased volume) + observation condition: breakout above KRW 95,500 with increased volume.
